notes:
PlaneSite 1.6.12:
- Better use of PPK results. Photos your PPK tool couldn't fully fix (float, or forward and backward runs that disagree) are now held to the accuracy the tool recorded for them, instead of being allowed to drift up to 2 m. Fixed photos are unchanged. On a PPK test flight the unfixed photos stayed within about 4 cm of their PPK positions instead of wandering about 80 cm, with the photos fitting together just as well.
- The log now shows the camera position adjustment separately for RTK-fixed and not-fixed photos.
